title: Autodesk 3D DXF schema contracts and open-source peer evidence boundaries
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and implementation-readiness refinement

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: The worktree was already broadly modified and uncommitted. This pass edited only the two plan documents and added this receipt; no prior or unrelated work was staged or committed.

sources.observation: The MESH table enumerates subdivision level, base cage, face list, edge, crease, and subentity override fields. The 3DSOLID table separates group-1/3 modeler carrier data from group-350 history reference. Common entity group ordering can vary.
sources.planDisposition: Keep MESH separate from classic polyface and 3DFACE; preserve modeler chunks and history edge separately; dispatch fields by group code without assuming serialized order. These are DXF field contracts only, not topology evaluation or ACIS/DWG semantics.

sources.observation: Documentation lists distinct built-in C++ and optional legacy DXF import sets, states embedded binary ACIS/SAT is unreadable, and routes DWG through an external converter to DXF followed by the selected importer.
sources.planDisposition: At composed native qualification, pin OS/architecture, FreeCAD build, converter, backend/preferences, and per-source disposition. Do not promote ACIS or undocumented MESH support from a generic import success.

sources.observation: browse-acis inspects and exports raw SAT/SAB; the drawing add-on does not render ACIS and has no 3D engine, projecting 3D entities into XY.
sources.planDisposition: Optional raw carrier/profile inspection only; not a general ACIS kernel, analytic geometry oracle, or 3D rendering acceptance route.

sources.observation: The v0.14.1 release notes state that the R2013+ AcDs store is not fully implemented and SAB blobs are extracted by a brute-force path; current source recognizes/dispatches the AcDs section. Those facts do not prove exact handle/key association, complete body extraction, writer preservation, or shape semantics.
sources.planDisposition: Use only as version-pinned differential evidence and compare entity handle, AcDs key, payload hash/profile, and body record disposition independently. Do not infer support from section detection, conversion success, or aggregate coverage claims.

sources.observation: The MESH DXF writer report first included a clone/setup workaround for an imported entity, but a later from-scratch MESH still serialized as ACAD_PROXY_ENTITY; the maintainer then identified writer defects and linked a fix listed in a release.
sources.planDisposition: Treat only as an exact-release writer test lead. At the optional peer checkpoint, use a generated from-scratch MESH; do not generalize issue status to all versions or add a duplicate local test without an uncovered invariant.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-07/S8: separate entity/schema, raw carrier, body topology, independent geometry, AcDs association, and native consumer acceptance
Existing DXF MESH owners: reuse typed fields, property overrides, version/class identity, ASCII/Binary profiles, and continuation boundaries
Existing modeler-carrier owners: test group-1/3 chunks and group-350 history references as distinct fields with following-record alignment
Existing composed peer checkpoint: exact-version ACadSharp MESH, LibreDWG AcDs, FreeCAD importer, and ezdxf raw-inspection routes

sequence: Continue the current dependency-ready local implementation queue; reuse existing generated ASCII/Binary, carrier, typed MESH, and ownership tests.
If a concrete local invariant is uncovered, add the smallest generated in-memory test with a following-record sentinel and run its fast owner only.
At the existing composed checkpoint, bind exact peer release/source/runtime and record per-entity and per-block carrier disposition; unavailable routes are NOT_RUN/NOT_QUALIFIED.
Keep explicit topology, ACIS carrier bytes, complete body-reachable records, independent analytic geometry, and native acceptance separate.
Keep external DWG/DXF fixtures out unless already tracked or created locally from scratch under the existing fixture policy; do not run full suites per slice.
implementationReadiness.supportBoundary: DXF schema coverage, MESH field roundtrip, raw SAT/SAB inspection, section recognition, parser success, and writer success do not establish evaluated 3D topology, ACIS shape semantics, entity-to-AcDs association, native acceptance, or any J item.

limitations: Primary-source documentation and peer issue/release pages were reviewed online. No peer executable, native CAD application, external drawing, or customer corpus was run/imported. The review found no new local defect and makes no support claim.
